facts.fact: Orzo 握着方向盘，让这个名字在脑子里回响——他在跟踪她的车。
他说当年对那个小孩毫无兴趣、所以把她留在那里——这是他对自己说的谎。
facts.anchor: When I met her all those years ago, I had zero interest. No care at all for the little child, it’s why I left her there.

facts.fact: 真相是她是他此生救过的唯一一个人，救她的同时他把自己也放了出来。
facts.anchor: But in truth she was the first and only person I had ever saved. A child that reminded me so much of myself it hurt. And in rescuing her, I had freed myself.

facts.fact: Reuben 的电话他不接，反正汇报也不会有什么内容。
facts.anchor: Reuben will have to wait for an update. And there won’t be much of one.

facts.fact: 毒曾经被下进 Aldente 家的可卡因货源里，如今没有证据表明还是这个路数。
facts.anchor: Before, the poison was slipped into the Aldente’s supply of cocaine, but there was no evidence that was still the case.

facts.fact: Reuben 传达 Benedict 的命令：名单上六个人必须全部消失。
facts.anchor: “Benedict has demanded action. We need all six gone.”

facts.fact: Reuben 决定杀六人的活外包出去，避免牵连到自己。
facts.anchor: He sighs exasperatedly. “Of course you didn’t. We’re outsourcing this.”

facts.fact: Durian 的手摸上 Cinnamon，Orzo 竭尽全力才忍住没当场杀他。
facts.anchor: It takes everything inside of me to not kill him. For touching her.

facts.fact: 他看到她鼻下的血痕，Unlucky 这个词沉进他胃里。
facts.anchor: On the dried blood below her nose. Unlucky.

facts.fact: 全章收尾的疑问：十六年前他的厄运消失——是不是他把坏运气给了她？
facts.anchor: What if I gave her my bad luck?
